manage_policies.name: manage_policies
manage_policies.description: FAO header parent link. Live accessible name is Manage Policies Home because aria-label wins over the visible text Manage Policies. The click accepts this data-at selector or one link/button whose accessible name matches ^Manage Policies. Hidden until Main Navigation is expanded once. Zero matches or more than one element holds.

policy_activity.name: policy_activity
policy_activity.description: Header link Policy Activity, or the Manage Policies landing link View policy activity reports. Either may be hidden until Main Navigation is expanded once. Two visible matches hold.

view_activity_by.name: view_activity_by
view_activity_by.description: Policy Activity View Activity By. Live select on hermes-test-01 release 3b651fadabb6. The accessible name and this selector must be the same single element. Choose option PROCESSEDDATE. Zero or multiple matches hold.

processed_date_option.name: processed_date_option
processed_date_option.description: Option inside View Activity By, not a page-wide search. Visible text must be Processed Date and the value must be PROCESSEDDATE. A second option with that value or that text holds.

processed_date_range.name: processed_date_range
processed_date_range.description: Date range shown after Processed Date is selected. Start, end, and Get Policy Activity are resolved inside this one element and must also be unique on the page.

processed_date_from.name: processed_date_from
processed_date_from.description: Inclusive processed-date start inside #PDDateRange. HTML date input, filled YYYY-MM-DD and read back. The accessible name Start Date must be this same element. The old label Processed date from is not on this page.

processed_date_to.name: processed_date_to
processed_date_to.description: Inclusive processed-date end inside #PDDateRange. HTML date input, filled YYYY-MM-DD and read back. The accessible name End Date must be this same element.

get_policy_activity.name: get_policy_activity
get_policy_activity.description: Submits the processed-date window. Live control value is Get Policy Activity. Resolved inside #PDDateRange and unique on the page. Search is the next step and is unchanged.

search.name: search
search.description: Clicked after Get Policy Activity. Live button name is still UNVERIFIED on a completed pull.

communications_tab.name: communications_tab
communications_tab.description: Communications tab. The run holds unless aria-selected becomes true.
